Fees

Hourly, or a project package.

Two simple ways to work together. Which one fits, and what it comes to, depends on the scope — we agree it together in our first call, before anything starts. No hidden fees, and travel and expenses are agreed in advance.

Hourly

Charged by the hour for the time actually worked — flexible when the scope is still taking shape, or the work is ongoing.

Project package

One agreed package for a defined piece of work — scope and deliverables fixed together upfront, so you know where you stand.
